intervention: In the second arm only, omit the declared continuous graded APL current to MBON05; retain APL state, arrivals, and every other APL target.
primary_endpoint: MBON05 threshold crossing and spike before cue end in each matched arm
pass_condition: baseline silent and APL-off MBON05 spikes before cue end, with exact start and current-balance attribution
fail_condition: both arms remain MBON05-silent with valid matched start and trace attribution
inconclusive_condition: start, source, event, or selective current-balance attribution mismatch
trace_sampling: Every integer-millisecond integration endpoint through cue end, plus maxima and exact accumulated interval contributions
